sentences.en: He wants to go to college to study geology.
sentences.zh: 他想去大学学习地质学。

sentences.en: My dream is to study geology at the University of Oxford.
sentences.zh: 我的梦想是去牛津大学学习地质学。

sentences.en: Geology is divided into various branches such as mineralogy, petrology, and physical geology.
sentences.zh: 地质学分为矿物学、岩石学和物理地质学等多个分支。

senses.zh: 地质学 - 地质情况 形容词: geologic
